summary: 22-year-old ATV rider plunged ~212 ft off a cliff at the Notch (sharp right turn on the old mining road atop Kennebec Pass, ~12,000 ft) in snowy conditions ~4:30 p.m. Saturday; rider helmeted, alert/oriented, called 911 himself (Spanish speaker, voice translation); numerous injuries (ribs, legs, back); 30 rescuers used a 213-ft rope on a 70-degree slope to pull him up shortly after midnight (~8-hr operation).
location: The Notch, old mining road atop Kennebec Pass, La Plata Mountains
responding_agency: La Plata County Search and Rescue; Durango Fire Protection District; Fort Lewis Mesa Fire Protection District
notes: Corrected during October 6, 2026 review: source was published November 22, 2023 and describes the preceding Saturday. This is a duplicate of 9538ed70-9514-4620-9647-d58e7e8b575d, not an August 2026 incident. Submitted UUID retained as a retired alias.
